_readme: rule_id -> family map for portfolio selection (plan 2026-07-02-004, Unit 1).
Single authority for the selection layer's per-family contribution vectors.
Covers every rule_id in the emitted-rule universe (COMPLEMENT_RULES registry,
RULE_GATES, DECLARATIVE_RULE_IDS, plus the rule_id string-literal scrape over
complement_rules/*.py — the scrape matches both the keyword form rule_id="x"
and the assignment form rule_id = "x", which is how tribal_density and
tribal_body are emitted in density.py).
Seeding: bench/forensics_report.py::rule_family() conventions —
repl_* -> replacement_stack, *_tribal -> tribal, *_feeder -> axis_feeder,
everything else groups as itself (identity) — then the deliberate merges
below. Identity-per-rule_id is the intended default; do NOT invent
aggressive groupings when adding entries.
Deliberate merges (R6):
1. lord + tribal_density + every *_tribal declarative rule -> 'tribal'.
Mandated sibling merge: all are the commander-is-a-tribal-axis signal.
2. tribal_body -> 'tribal'. Conservative sibling merge: tribal_body is the
same tribal-membership mechanic as tribal_density, split by payoff
direction under the tribal-payoff tier (density.py); counting them as
separate families would let a tribal flood evade its own family mass.
3. spell_density + spellcast_resonance -> 'spell'. Mandated sibling merge:
both fire on the spells-matter axis (density count vs resonance framing).
Known divergences from rules_seed.json per-row 'family' fields (that field
is untouched — editing it flips the config hash for nothing; see plan Key
Technical Decision 'Family-map authority'): repl_* spelled
'replacement-stack' there vs 'replacement_stack' here (forensics spelling);
monarch_synergy ('political'), toughness_synergy ('scaling'),
party_feeder ('scaling'), etb_tapped_stax_feeder ('stax') keep this map's
convention-derived families. Each pair is allowlisted with rationale in
tests/test_family_map.py::test_consistent_with_rules_seed_family_field.
Maintenance: every newly registered rule_id needs an entry here
(tests/test_family_map.py coverage test); scaffold_rule.py write-path
closure lands in Unit 3 (Phase B). Not yet folded into
compute_config_hash — hash wiring is Unit 6.
